statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH (yellow). Four hours after the Globex reopen the 28,981.00-29,100.00 band is still unchanged and NQ trades at 29,015.75 (-1.26%), but in the lower half of that band rather than the upper half, with Hong Kong and mainland China cash opening into it. Tail holds at 20 rather than easing because WTI has extended to 103.16 at a fresh 103.44 session high, while Stress stays at 77 on a 10-year near 4.97%, record diesel above 6 dollars a gallon and a Wednesday FOMC decision with projections.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold, so the mapped state is WATCH for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. The danger window is moved forward to 13:00-16:00 UTC, covering the US cash open at 13:30 UTC and the first full cash hour, which is the first US auction to price the weekend AI-slowdown story; the forecast peaks at 22 there. The named invalidation for the constructive read is unchanged: a decisive loss of the 28,981.00 reopen low on shallow pullbacks, with the nearest test the greater-China cash opens near 01:30 UTC and the 07:00 UTC European cash open. Monday's US calendar holds only routine 3-month and 6-month bill auctions at 15:30 UTC.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures hold an unchanged 28,981-29,100 band for a fourth hour at -1.26% as AI-slowdown calls and a 103-dollar crude tape meet the Asian cash opens
body:
A fourth consecutive hour of live price-path evidence leaves the constructive structural read intact while the cross-asset backdrop deteriorates at the margin. NQ is quoted at 29,015.75, down 371.25 or 1.26% against the 29,387.00 reference close, as of 21:15 EDT. The decisive structural point is that the day's range is still exactly 28,981.00 to 29,100.00, the same 119-point band printed in the first hour after the reopen. Four hours without range expansion, following a retracement off the reopen low that extended rather than failed, is the opposite of the repeated-extension-after-failed-pullback structure that would push Tail toward the blocking band. The qualification is that price has rotated from the upper half of that band into the lower half, so the 28,981.00 low is closer than it was an hour ago.

The catalyst is sector-specific rather than systemic. Leaders of the largest AI platforms, including Anthropic's Dario Amodei and OpenAI's Sam Altman, publicly called over the weekend for a slowdown in frontier model development, which reprices the pace assumption underneath the sector that has led this year's advance. The cross-asset evidence confirms that reading: ES trades at 7,622.25, down 0.49%, so NQ is underperforming the broad index by roughly two and a half times, and the Treasury complex is close to unchanged with the 10-year at 4.97% and the 2-year at 4.63%. That is a tech de-rating, not an aligned risk-off cascade. Conflict of this kind normally lowers directional conviction and raises Stress rather than Tail.

Asia has given the first independent read. The Nikkei 225 traded down to 62,726.18 and has recovered to 63,062.34, down 1.48%, as of 01:10 UTC, so the index most exposed to semiconductor supply-chain read-through made a new low and then retraced. That completed retracement is the single most important piece of new evidence since the previous hour, and it weakens rather than strengthens the case for a pathological no-retracement path. Hong Kong and mainland China cash are opening into this hour and have not yet printed a session.

Energy is the driver moving the wrong way. WTI is at 103.16, up 3.11%, having printed a fresh session high of 103.44, with Brent above 107. The Saudi East-West pipeline, capable of 7 million barrels a day and the main route bypassing the Strait of Hormuz, remains shut after drone attacks on 10 September, and the Salalah talks between Iran and Gulf states on the strait were postponed rather than held. US diesel set a record above 6 dollars a gallon on Friday. That combination is why Stress holds at 77 in the high band even as the NQ structure itself stays orderly, and it is the channel most likely to complicate Wednesday's FOMC decision, projections and press conference.

Confidence rises to 84. The assessment now rests on four hours of continuous live futures pricing plus independently verified Asian cash, energy, rates and catalyst evidence. The shared Finviz cross-asset context was 104 minutes old at assessment time and therefore outside its freshness bound, so it was not relied upon; the conclusions above come from directly fetched primary quotes and verified reporting.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding published hours were available. Tail rose steadily through the weekend from 6 at 01:00 UTC to 17 by 15:00 UTC, eased to 16, then stepped through 17, 18, 18, 19, 21 and 22 as the Globex reopen approached and arrived, crossing into the watch band at 21:00 UTC, before settling back to 20 for the final two hours as the reopen low held. The mapped state was EA_ON and green for the first 20 hours and WATCH and yellow for the final four. Stress climbed without interruption from 57 to 78 as the pre-FOMC rates and energy backdrop accumulated, easing marginally to 77 for the last two hours. Confidence held near 86 through the weekend, stepped down to the low-to-mid 70s from 16:00 UTC as the evidence gap widened, then recovered through 78, 80 and 82 once the reopen restored a live price path. The dominant mode was normal for 21 of the 24 hours, event/whipsaw at the reopen and mixed in the final two.
outlookSummary: The concentrated conditional risk has moved forward to the 13:00-16:00 UTC stretch around the 13:30 UTC US cash open, the first US auction to price the weekend AI-slowdown story, and the forecast peaks at 22 in the first full cash hour rather than entering the block band because four hours of trade have passed without range expansion. Two nearer checkpoints precede it: the greater-China cash opens in the current hour, where the forecast holds at 20, and the 07:00 UTC European cash open, where it returns to 20. Between them the base case is continued absorption, with Tail decaying to a window low of 17 through the European pre-US lull. The named invalidation throughout is a decisive break of the 28,981.00 reopen low accompanied by shallow or failed pullbacks. Monday's US calendar holds only routine 3-month and 6-month bill auctions at 15:30 UTC, so residual daytime risk is headline-driven, with crude the main transmission channel while the Saudi East-West pipeline stays shut and the Salalah talks stay postponed. Stress remains in the high band across the entire window, between 72 and 77, because the FOMC decision and projections on Wednesday, crude above 103 dollars, record diesel and a 10-year near 4.97% do not resolve inside it. Confidence decays from 84 to 67 across the 24 hours as the live evidence anchoring the assessment ages.
